title: Remove role-play/cosplay/novelty language and update Falcon IDs gothic wordmark branding everywhere

requirements.text: Remove all references to role-play, props, novelty use, and cosplay from all user-facing warnings, disclaimers, and page copy across the site, rewriting the remaining copy so it reads realistic and professional while keeping a concise legality/validity notice where appropriate.

quotes: Remove all references to role-play, props, novelty use, or cosplay from warnings, disclaimers, and page text so the brand feels realistic and professional

acceptanceCriteria: No user-facing text contains the words/phrases: "role-play", "roleplay", "cosplay", "props", or "novelty use" (case-insensitive).

Update the following known locations so they comply: frontend/src/content/copy.ts (e.g., LANDING_DISCLAIMER, ORDER_FORM_DISCLAIMER), frontend/src/components/NoveltyDisclaimerBanner.tsx, frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx (hero subtitle + disclaimer block), frontend/src/pages/NewOrderPage.tsx (disclaimer block), frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.tsx (card footer line).
Any remaining disclaimer/notice text is written in clear, professional English and does not imply roleplay/cosplay/props/novelty usage.

requirements.text: Replace the current logo everywhere with a Gothic-style “Falcon IDs” wordmark, including the header, landing page hero, footer branded areas (if any), and any other visible branded placements.

quotes: replace the current logo everywhere with Gothic-style lettering that says “Falcon IDs” in the header, footer, favicon, and all branded areas.

acceptanceCriteria: All pages that currently render the logo image (e.g., frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx and frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) are updated to use the new Gothic “Falcon IDs” wordmark asset(s).
No old logo asset filenames remain referenced in the frontend codebase (e.g., /assets/generated/falcon-ids-logo-transparent.dim_1200x300.png is no longer used).
The displayed brand text reads exactly “Falcon IDs” (spacing/case) in all branded placements.

requirements.text: Update site icons to match the new Gothic “Falcon IDs” branding by replacing the favicon and apple-touch icon references in frontend/index.html with the new branded assets.

quotes: replace the current logo everywhere with Gothic-style lettering that says “Falcon IDs” in the header, footer, favicon, and all branded areas.

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html <link rel="icon"> points to the new favicon asset.
frontend/index.html <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> points to the new apple-touch icon asset.
The browser tab icon and iOS home-screen icon reflect the updated Gothic “Falcon IDs” branding.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not add a support/ticket system or admin responses.
Do not add a helper feature called “Falcon” or any Q&A system.
Do not perform a broad performance/optimization refactor beyond what is necessary to implement the branding/copy changes.

required: Gothic-style wordmark reading “Falcon IDs”, transparent background (falcon-ids-wordmark-gothic-transparent.dim_1200x300.png)
Gothic-style “Falcon IDs” favicon, high-contrast, legible at small sizes (falcon-ids-favicon-gothic.dim_32x32.png)
Gothic-style “Falcon IDs” apple touch icon, centered with padding (falcon-ids-apple-touch-gothic.dim_180x180.png)
